evidence:
Shared-state model: test.sh launches one app process (tests/test.sh:104-113) and runs the gates suite then the scored suite against it (test.sh:203-227), so render, constraints, functional, polish and visual all share one database; functional also restarts it via restart_app (single use). Dimension execution order is not fixed by the task and was not measured, so I checked every seed-absolute expectation against every other dimension's permitted mutations, in either order.

Cross-review wording present: app_context.md:27-31 'every review can create its own job and cards ... Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count.' functional/prompt.md:15 'Earlier reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages. Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review), never move another review's records, and never rely on starting counts.' polish/prompt.md:14 'Use your own new job and cards ... never rely on another review's records' and 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own.' polish/prompt.md:24 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation.' visual/prompt.md:42 review read-only, 'Do not move cards or send messages.' render/prompt.md:9 'Do not create, move or send anything, and do not open any conversation.' constraints/prompt.md:22 'Do not open a job, move, reject or message anything here'. Every gate (constraints criterion and each scored dimension's global gate) adds a uniquely named card to Data Analyst Applied and finds 'that'/'the same' card, so accumulated gate cards from other dimensions cannot confuse it.

Seed-absolute expectations and who could disturb them:
(1) functional Z / hro_unread_counts 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread' (prompt.md:33; seed reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages = 1). Only Lena's own opening or a new message in APP-301 changes it; no other dimension signs in as Lena or writes there (polish forbids Lena's conversation; visual uses Rafael and Noor read-only; gates never open conversations). Protected.
(2) functional Z / hro_restart seeded Platform Engineer order (Applied Greta, Ade, Marco; Screen Priya, Samuel - matches seed APP-105/106/108, APP-103/104) and Noor's note (seed notes[0]). Gates mutate only Data Analyst Applied; polish uses its own job and notes only on 'your cards'; visual moves nothing. Z is read 'before anything else' inside functional, and D compares against that observed baseline (lesson 16 pattern). Protected.
(3) functional K seeded statuses (Noor Platform Engineer Interviewing, Product Designer Application received; Tomas Data Analyst In review): no other dimension moves seeded cards. Protected.
(4) Noor's long conversation (120 at start, app_context.md:29-31) is mutated by polish (hro_pol_live_thread, possibly hro_pol_failed_send) and drafts by functional T. Functional thread rows are relative: hro_thread_latest 'most recent 30', hro_thread_earlier pages of 30 with remaining count verifiable by loading to the end, U scrolled-up reads 'before and after'; app_context explicitly says never rely on the 120. Polish thread rows (live_thread, earlier_place) are position/relative and clear leftover drafts first.
(5) Unread/seen rows run on functional's own new J2 conversation and count relative to observed sequence ('rises by exactly two', Mei's count 'computed from the observed sequence'); T has a fallback to Tomas's seeded conversation 'with counts read relative to their values before you act'.
(6) Restart: only functional calls restart_app; a polish or visual run after it simply sees a restarted app with persisted data and signs in fresh; nothing in them assumes pre-restart sessions.
(7) hro_activity / filter: graded only on J1/J2 created in this review, so other dimensions' jobs and lines on other jobs cannot break 'shows all of that job's lines and only those'.

Broken-app probe: an app that reseeds or resets on every request would fail Z/D or the gate readbacks rather than be credited by a pristine-seed assumption; nothing passes merely because seed values happen to be present (e.g. hro_restart also requires your own jobs, notes, messages, unread and activity unchanged). Conforming-alternative probe: a correct app run with polish before functional still shows Lena 1 unread, the seeded Platform Engineer order/note and seeded candidate statuses, because no other dimension is permitted to change them; Noor's extra messages are absorbed by relative wording.

Residual (P3, not a defect): functional prompt lacks polish's 'clear a leftover draft first' line. If polish ran earlier, its hro_pol_session_resume deliberately leaves a Rafael reply draft in some conversation; functional T's 'type a different unsent reply in another conversation' might append to it. hro_drafts only fails on a lost or moved draft, so a correct app still passes; similarly polish's 'Mei sees an empty box' could see a stray Mei draft only if a functional Mei send failed mid-typing. Unmeasured: no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so), so judge compliance with these instructions and actual dimension order are NOT EXERCISED; this row is a design check satisfied by the source wording.
